scope: Specified funded three-cut test and the general even-parity companion and quiet-reference invariants.
claim: A newborn must write a deviation on a new mark which a real payment carries to a parent of a fixed later join. Diverting the upstream signal restores that funded join. The primary not-all-equal reference makes the delivered bit individually decisive. Even parity forces another deviation on any active holder, and the alternative not-all-equal reference forces a companion on this source. A quiet start stays quiet.
